title: Measured value response with counter-interrogation cause
purpose: Exercise the server-to-client monitoring path with a documented short floating-point measurement type and a documented counter-interrogation cause.
expected_behavior: The peer parses the server-to-client I-format ASDU as one short floating-point measured value associated with cause 3, preserving the measurement value and quality descriptor fields.
constraints_preserved: Type 13 is the documented M_ME_NC_1 short floating-point measured value.
The ASDU retains type, VSQ, two-octet cause, common address, three-octet IOA, four-octet value, and one-octet quality descriptor ordering.
The I-format length 0x12 equals four control octets plus fourteen ASDU octets.
The frame uses a nonzero IOA and a finite IEEE-754 value rather than the historical issue body.
issue_safety_notes: This covers a server-to-client I-format path structurally related to the reported crash call chain without using the historical payload or its length/control-field combination.
